description: This file defines classes and templates for handling Netlink communication in the Thunder project, including message framing, parameter handling, and socket management, specifically for Linux-based systems.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class representing a Netlink message, providing serialization, deserialization, and sequence management.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Template class for constructing Netlink message parameters with header and attributes.

classes.name: Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over and validating Netlink message frames within a received data buffer.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific Netlink connector message types, handling acknowledgment and message parsing.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Class managing a Netlink socket, supporting sending, receiving, and processing Netlink messages.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the Netlink message including headers and attributes.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the Netlink message with specified type and value.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current frame is valid within the buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next message frame in the buffer.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the message type of the current frame.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the message.

methods.name: Flags
methods.description: Returns the flags associated with the message.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data payload of the message.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the current message payload.

methods.name: RawData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the raw data of the current frame.

methods.name: RawSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the raw data.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the outbound Netlink message.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the outbound Netlink message.

methods.name: Flags
methods.description: Returns the flags of the outbound Netlink message.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into the Netlink message object.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingests a raw stream into the connector message parser.

methods.name: Acknowledge
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgment number for the connector message.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket, optionally waiting for a response.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a response, handling both outbound and inbound messages.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming data frames into Netlink messages.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the socket buffer.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the socket buffer.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in the socket connection.
